summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing that the European Commission approved Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan) in combination with pertuzumab for first-line treatment of HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. Approval follows positive CHMP opinion and is based on DESTINY-Breast09 Phase III trial data showing reduced risk of progression or death by 44% versus THP, with median progression-free survival of 40.7 months versus 26.9 months. This is a routine regulatory approval announcement for a pharmaceutical product, not a special situation. No deal terms, financial transactions, or strategic events are involved.
